From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@stratushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Stratus redlines — need legal posture on indemnity & SLA caps

Michael / team — reading through their comments. Summary and proposed position below: 

1) Term / auto-renew — commercial decision. If sales accepts 12 months no auto-renew, we should include a 60-day pre-expiry notice requirement to protect retention. (Proposed clause: Customer may provide notice of non-renewal no later than 60 days before contract expiration.)

2) Indemnity (MSA §7) — Stratus requests narrower indemnity and removal of 'gross negligence' carveback. We should: (a) keep Redwood's indemnity as-is for IP claims, (b) limit customer-indemnified third-party claims for model outputs to willful misconduct, and (c) add language about mutual indemnification for breaches of confidentiality. Draft redline attached (PDF) with tracked changes.

3) SLA credit cap — they want to align with their policy; they proposed 12 months of fees. We recommend a compromise at 3 months of fees; as a strategic account, I can accept up to 6 months but will need exec approval. Please confirm the requested cap from finance.

4) Data residency — they asked for EU-only residency for a subset of data. We do not have a guaranteed EU-only on the standard hosted plan; propose inclusion of a data processing addendum for EU data plus an optional Private deployment appendix if they require strict residency.

5) Overage/burst pricing — this is pricing ops. Karthik / Monica: please provide an overage surcharge rate and a maximum monthly dollar cap we can accept.

I'll prepare the MSA redline and a cover note summarizing concessions vs. non-starters.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: MSA_redline_20270216.pdf
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift — next steps and proposed sign path

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround and for flagging the key items. Outline of next steps and our negotiated positions: 

1) Term: We can move to 12 months with manual renewal. We'll add a 60-day non-renewal notice clause.

2) Indemnity & data residency: Laura has prepared a clean redline that narrows the indemnity around model output claims and proposes a data processing addendum for EU residency. Attached for your legal review (MSA_redline_20270216.pdf).

3) SLA credit cap: Our recommended compromise is 3 months of fees. If Stratus requires higher (up to 6 months), I'll escalate for exec approval — please confirm which you prefer.

4) Overage/burst: Karthik & Monica propose $0.008 per excess token with a monthly overage cap of $18,000 for the first year. If that works, we'll incorporate it into Exhibit B and reflect the cap in the order form.

5) Sign path: Once you confirm (term + SLA cap + overage cap), we'll drop the revised order form and redlined MSA into DocuSign for signature. DocuSign link will be shared to Alex and your procurement contact.

Attachments: MSA_redline_20270216.pdf, Stratus_Health_OrderForm_v3.docx
DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/Signing/?s=abc123def456

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
